additional_concerns: The PDF and XML method-listing statements are supported, but their conditions are not exhaustive. Footnote 3 is supplied and requires e-Cert; both claims incorrectly describe it as missing. A reading that grants permission solely on the extracted conditions is not established. This distinction preserves the unresolved source-support disagreement.

XML use also requires following the separately provided JFIU XML schema and liaising to arrange a technical test. Successful completion of a test is not expressly made a prerequisite to every submission; adding that restriction would require support.

The prescribed PDF form and JFIU XML schema are missing and cannot reliably be mapped to the anonymous dependency IDs. NONE_DECLARED below concerns establishing the listed methods, not detailed submission compliance. The latter assessment would require these missing materials.

node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes all of 2 February 2026. The other candidates select 9:00am. The source distinguishes “With effect from 2 February 2026” from operational launch at 9:00am, while the trigger says “following its implementation”. These unrelated claim checks do not resolve the competing readings, exact boundary treatment or governing timezone. Authoritative JFIU or SFC clarification is not supplied or mapped to a dependency ID.

Urgent blackout contact is permitted, but contact alone does not establish submission. A genuine submission must not be excluded merely because it involved direct contact. Migration of existing records does not itself establish a new submission event.

node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb places actual submission in the result; the other event candidates place it in scope. Non-submission events can therefore produce FALSE versus OUT_OF_SCOPE. Equivalence depends on the intended assessment domain.

The history candidate delegates event existence and evidential completeness to an external Boolean; the formula does not inspect histories. The relationship between the responsible entity and each original submitter also requires factual assessment.

A later resubmission does not erase a historical trigger. TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must retain the typed DUTY_TRIGGER meaning, rather than imply completion or an outstanding duty. Extraction defects do not automatically establish executable defects, and these labels neither establish overall correctness nor authorize pruning.
